title: dryopteris aculeatum subsp. lobata
intro: Dryopteris aculeatum subsp. lobata, commonly known as the Lobed Shield Fern, is a type of fern that belongs to the Dryopteridaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, lower blood pressure, and improve digestion. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris aculeatum subsp. lobata include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
